* '''Original''' ([[Endor: Anakin's Funeral Pyre (ALT)]]): Alternate-image card image first published 24 February 2024<ref name="img-o">Players Committee card image as published: <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/endoranakinsfuneralpyre_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d660492911547170d55af7c4f2a7d4aad605ec2a/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/endoranakinsfuneralpyre_ai.png holotable commit d660492], 24 February 2024); <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/endoranakinsfuneralpyre_ai.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/50d464c03a6e42edb650f994e0d31985ddd171c5/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/endoranakinsfuneralpyre_ai.gif holotable commit 50d464c], 25 February 2024) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same image).</ref>: “Light: If you just chose I Have It on your [Skywalker] Epic Event, deploy Like My Father Before Me from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
